integrity.proof_basis: explicit Frobenius descent and finite matching enumeration

scientific_limitations: Counts refer to literal coefficient values, not isomorphism classes of curves or isogeny codomains.
Some maximal isotropic quotients are products of elliptic curves; every counted object is a kernel, not necessarily a new genus-two Jacobian.
Uniform finite-field theorem proved algebraically; independent checking of arbitrary nonprime extension fields is not a finite certificate.
Priority subject to previously unnoticed equivalent treatment of this specific D4 pencil or a stronger specialization; independent audit not performed.
title: Rational Richelot kernels and Frobenius splitting in the \(D_4\) genus-two pencil
